content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission has published an update for UPSSSC Auditor / Assistant Accountant 2024 Final Result.

Use this page as a quick listing only. Open the official website, download the result PDF or scorecard, and confirm your roll number before treating the outcome as final.

How to check

  1. Go to upsssc.gov.in
  2. Open the Results / Latest notice section
  3. Download the PDF or log in with your credentials
  4. Read cut-off, next-stage and document-verification instructions if they are in the same notice

NaukriMitra does not declare government results. The recruiting body website is the only authentic source.
